items.title: Bitcoin Slips Below $83,000 After Hotter-Than-Expected US Inflation Data
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Bitcoin Slips Below $83,000 After Hotter-Than-Expected US Inflation Data  
 The price of bitcoin slid Wednesday after data dropped showing that U.S. consumer prices shot up more than expected in September due to rising gasoline prices.  The biggest cryptocurrency by market cap was recently trading for close to $82,827 after dropping nearly 1% over a 24-hour period. At one point on Wednesday morning in New […] 
 This post  Bitcoin Slips Below $83,000 After Hotter-Than-Expected US Inflation Data  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Mathew Di

items.title: Capitalism is Broken and Bitcoin is the Great Equalizer | Natalie Brunell
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Capitalism is Broken and Bitcoin is the Great Equalizer | Natalie Brunell  
 Young people are angry at capitalism, but Natalie Brunell says they blame the wrong target. She explains how Bitcoin can fix a rigged bank-fiat system. 
 This post  Capitalism is Broken and Bitcoin is the Great Equalizer | Natalie Brunell  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Mark Mason .
